From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachael Smith <rachael@aurelia.com>, Jorge Pena <j.pena@edgewave.io>, Elena Novak <elena.novak@tidalai.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact cohort demo — runbook, agenda & fallback routing

Hi all,

Thanks again for signing up for the compact cohort office hours we’re running this week. Quick note to get everyone aligned before Wednesday’s 45-minute session (aimed at multiple prospects — compact technical walkthrough + Q&A):

- Goal: show inference latency/cost tradeoffs and a short live demo of routing and model fallback policies.
- Format: 20min live demo, 15min hands-on Q&A, 10min dedicated next-steps & procurement questions.
- Hosts: Neha (demo lead) + Ben (sales cadence). Stephanie will handle infra deep-dive if we need to dig into kernels/runtime.

Attachments: agenda (PDF) + attendee roster (CSV) + runbook (MD) — please review.

Can each of you confirm availability and any must-see topics (quantization questions, VPC install, or SLA/throughput benchmarks)? If the cohort needs a different timezone/fallback we’ll publish a backup slot.

Proposed time: Wed, Apr 21, 2026 17:00–17:45 PT — calendar link in the doc.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0181

Attachments: 2026-04-20_compact-cohort_agenda.pdf (PDF), attendee_roster_apr20.csv (CSV), runbook_fallbacks_v1.md (MD)

From: Rachael Smith <rachael@aurelia.com>

Cc: Jorge Pena <j.pena@edgewave.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact cohort demo — runbook, agenda & fallback routing

Neha — thanks for the overview and the materials. Quick confirmation: the proposed Wed 17:00 PT works for our team, but we have two logistical asks:

1) Two of our engineers are back-to-back until 17:15 PT. Could we start with a 5-minute recap of the product surface so late joiners don’t miss crucial context?
2) We may want a short session at the end (5–7 min) focused on security/compliance (SOC2 + data retention) — is Stephanie the right person to cover that?

Also, I attached an initial attendee list (first + last name, role) and a note about timezones. If you need us to push the cohort by 30m to 17:30 PT to accommodate internal calendars we can be flexible, but prefer 17:00 PT.

Rachael Smith
Head of Engineering | Aurelia Systems
rachael@aurelia.com

Attachments: attendee_roster_apr20.csv (CSV)

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 11:20:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Compact cohort demo — runbook, agenda & fallback routing

Neha — forwarding Rachael’s note. A couple internal logistics:

- If Rachael’s engs join late, we can record the first 10 minutes and add a 5-min posted recap for late joiners. I can handle the recording and short summary.
- Stephanie — can you add a 7-min SOC2/data-retention mini-slot at the end? If yes, I’ll update the agenda and send the calendar update.
- Marcus — we may need an additional host in case the primary GPU pool is saturated; can you put a standby slot on Dedicated capacity (low-latency fallback) for Wed 17:00–18:00 PT? We’d only failover if we see queued requests > 200ms for median.

If everyone agrees I’ll ship the updated agenda and calendar invite by noon.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks all — shipping a small update after internal sync. Changes:

- Start: 17:05 PT (5-min recap + intros) — keeps the demo crisp for late joiners.
- Demo flow: 10min product overview, 20min live demo (routing + model fallback), 10min infra & SOC2 (Stephanie), 5–10min next steps.
- Standby fallback: Marcus has reserved Dedicated pool slot 17:00–18:00 PT (ID: DED-standby-0430). We’ll only route if median token latency > 200ms or concurrency > 8 per model shard.
- Recording: Ben will record first 12 minutes and post a 5-min recap for late joiners.

I updated the agenda and attendee roster in the attached PDF/CSV. Calendar invite updated (new start time). If anyone needs an earlier/later alternate slot we also have Thu 09:00 PT as a backup.

Best,
Neha
